chapters.title: Translation is not the hard part
The invisible wall in global business
From raw transcript to intent review

takeaways: Accurate translation does not guarantee shared understanding, because high-context communication carries meaning in tone, timing and what is left unsaid.
Teams Premium features such as live translation, interpreter and intelligent recap work best as a context recovery layer that shows where intent may have slipped.
Run a short intent review after high-stakes meetings and send a follow-up that tests meaning, owners and approvals instead of repeating notes.
hook: Global meetings often end with clean transcripts and polished recaps, yet everyone leaves with a different understanding of what was agreed. This episode shows leaders and project teams how to use Teams Premium and a simple intent review to catch soft resistance, vague ownership and false alignment. The result is fewer revision loops and faster, clearer decisions across cultures.
